_doc: Approved hero/branding artwork after the 2026-09-20 IP remediation. qa_deep treats any hero-(home|cleveland|greenbay|dallas|michigan).* file as blocked unless its basename is listed here. To replace a hero: regenerate the art, have it reviewed against DESIGN-BLUEPRINT 2 (no marks, no faces, no numbers, no press photos), then add the basename with the review date and a description of what the art shows.

hero-home.art: typography only: GAME DAY STARTS HERE across four team-colour panels; no marks, no helmets, no numerals
